title: Lens Material Availability and Upgrade Prices — Northgate Optical
content:
Each Northgate Optical lens design is made only in the lens materials listed for it. A material other than standard plastic is charged as a material upgrade at the price shown for that design; standard plastic carries no upgrade price.

## Materials made, by design

| Lens design | Standard plastic | Polycarbonate | Trivex | 1.60 high index | 1.67 high index | 1.74 high index |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Single Vision Lenses | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Northgate Lined Bifocal Lenses | yes | yes | yes | yes | no | no |
| Northgate Lined Trifocal Lenses | yes | yes | yes | no | no | no |
| Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | no |
| Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

## Upgrade price from standard plastic (USD)

| Lens design | Polycarbonate | Trivex | 1.60 high index | 1.67 high index | 1.74 high index |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Single Vision Lenses | 25.00 | 40.00 | 40.00 | 60.00 | 110.00 |
| Northgate Lined Bifocal Lenses | 25.00 | 40.00 | 40.00 | 0.00 (not made) | 0.00 (not made) |
| Northgate Lined Trifocal Lenses | 25.00 | 40.00 | 0.00 (not made) | 0.00 (not made) | 0.00 (not made) |
| Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses | 30.00 | 45.00 | 45.00 | 70.00 | 0.00 (not made) |
| Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses | 30.00 | 45.00 | 45.00 | 70.00 | 120.00 |
| Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses | 30.00 | 45.00 | 45.00 | 70.00 | 120.00 |

A price of 0.00 marks a material the design is not made in; it is never a free upgrade.

## Patients under 18

For every lens design in the table, impact resistance is required for minors: eyewear for a patient under 18 is made only in polycarbonate or Trivex.

## Points of judgement

- *Can a Northgate Lined Trifocal Lenses job be ordered in 1.67 high index?* No. The design is made in standard plastic, polycarbonate and Trivex only.
- *What does a Trivex upgrade cost on Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses?* 45.00, the Trivex column for that design.
- *Is standard plastic acceptable for a 15-year-old patient?* No; under 18 the eyewear is made only in polycarbonate or Trivex, whatever the design.
